# Dean Chen (deanchen.me) — Vibecoding Portfolio & Blog

> Personal website, interactive web application portfolio, and blog of **Dean Chen**, Software Engineer at **Google** (working on open-source AI Agent infrastructure `google/adk-python`, M.S. @ CMU, B.S. in CS @ SJTU).

- Website: https://deanchen.me/
- About: https://deanchen.me/about/
- GitHub: https://github.com/DeanChensj
- Sitemap: https://deanchen.me/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: https://deanchen.me/feed.xml

## 1. Interactive Web Apps & Builds (`deanchen.me/*`)

- **[江山时序 · Jiangshan Historical Atlas of China](https://deanchen.me/jiangshan-map/)**:
  - Interactive historical atlas timeline spanning 2,400+ years of Chinese history (403 BCE Warring States to 2026 CE) across 18 eras and 164 territorial & administrative snapshots (`州/郡/府/道/路/行省`), Yellow River course shifts, 788 ancient-to-modern city genealogies (`点地溯源`), 20 strategic mountain passes, and classical poetry/historical figure trajectories.
  - Dedicated LLM Guide & Deep-Link Protocol: https://deanchen.me/jiangshan-map/llms.txt
  - Sitemap: https://deanchen.me/jiangshan-map/sitemap.xml
  - Source Code: https://github.com/DeanChensj/jiangshan-map

- **[硅谷人生重开模拟器 · SV Life Reboot Simulator](https://deanchen.me/sv-life-reboot/)**:
  - Immersive life and career simulation game for Silicon Valley software engineers featuring 231+ story events, 27+ achievements, F1/OPT/H1B/PERM/Green Card immigration chains, L3 to L8 career progression, Bay Area real estate, and FIRE simulation.
  - Source Code: https://github.com/DeanChensj/sv-life-reboot

- **[Credit Card Benefits Tracker](https://deanchen.me/cc-benefits-tracker/)**:
  - One-stop dashboard to track recurring monthly, quarterly, semiannual, and annual credit card statement credits, perks, and effective annual fees.
  - Source Code: https://github.com/DeanChensj/cc-benefits-tracker

- **[World Cup Interactive Map](https://deanchen.me/world-cup-map/)**:
  - Interactive geographical data visualization exploring FIFA World Cup tournament history, host nations, championship runs, and global football footprints.
  - Source Code: https://github.com/DeanChensj/world-cup-map

- **[Google Agent Development Kit (`google/adk-python`)](https://github.com/google/adk-python)**:
  - Open-source, code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying deterministic and dynamic multi-agent workflows.
